reviews.title: Fast!
reviews.comment: Super fast drive huge upgrade over my old SSD. Install was simple and it was recognized right away. Load times are noticeably quicker and everything feels more responsive. The built-in heatsink is a nice bonus and keeps temps in check. Definitely worth it if you want top-tier performance.
reviews.author: Nick
